purpose: five-paper API feasibility diagnostic and reusable metadata adapters

proposed_source_roles.OpenAlex: primary_candidate_source; not approved as sole source
proposed_source_roles.Semantic Scholar Academic Graph: secondary_candidate_source; not approved as sole verifier
proposed_source_roles.OpenCitations Index: independent DOI-edge verifier candidate; coverage limited to indexed DOI relationships
proposed_source_roles.Crossref: independent deposited-reference verifier candidate; coverage limited to Crossref records and deposited references

diagnostic_sample.method: ascending SHA-256 of namespace plus canonical arXiv ID after focal exclusions

matching.arxiv_identifier_lookup: attempt source-native arXiv ID or arXiv landing-page matching

acquisition.retry_policy: adapter default: bounded retries for transport errors, HTTP 429 and HTTP 5xx; Retry-After honored when supplied
acquisition.note: Adapters support optional append-only JSON caching. No persistent diagnostic cache was created.

edge_verification_constraints.opencitations_identifier_requirement: DOI, PMID, ISSN, ISBN, or OpenCitations OMID; arXiv ID is not accepted
edge_verification_constraints.crossref_identifier_requirement: DOI for direct work lookup; query search may resolve candidates but does not establish identity
edge_verification_constraints.crossref_reference_coverage: Only references deposited by Crossref members; omitted reference lists are unknown, not evidence of no edge
edge_verification_constraints.opencitations_reference_coverage: Edges available only when present in OpenCitations Index; omitted edges are unknown, not evidence of no edge

note: Diagnostic feasibility results do not select or freeze the E6 literature testbed.
